name: Perrigo Company plc
tagline: Leading Pure-Play Self-Care Company Providing Health and Wellness Solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: La marge brute est le KPI clé pour Perrigo, leader du marché OTC des soins personnels en libre-service. Elle reflète la capacité de l'entreprise à maintenir la rentabilité face aux pressions inflationnistes, aux tarifs douaniers et aux coûts croissants des matières premières. C'est un indicateur essentiel pour une entreprise de biens de consommation courante.

kpis.explanation: Share of revenue remaining after paying production costs.
kpis.signal: Margin under pressure from inflation and tariffs.
kpis.description: Gross margin impacted by rising raw material costs, geopolitical tensions and U.S. tariffs. Strategic pricing actions and supply chain reinvention initiatives have helped mitigate impacts.

kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin declines due to persistent inflationary costs, organizational adjustments and investments in efficiency programs including Project Energize.

kpis.signal: Significant reduction in capital investments in 2024.
kpis.description: Capital expenditure reduced in 2024, notably deferring the Nutrition Network Optimization project, as part of cost rationalization and working capital optimization initiatives.

kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.signal: Continued headcount reduction as part of transformation.
kpis.description: Perrigo continues organizational rationalization with declining headcount through efficiency programs including Project Energize, supporting margin stabilization objectives.

ai_positioning.summary: Perrigo does not mention any artificial intelligence initiatives in recent financial documents. The company focuses on supply chain reinvention, cost management and operational stability.
evidence: No mention of AI or related technologies in the 10-K
IT investments focus on cybersecurity and information systems, not AI
Innovations cited are product-related, not digital or algorithmic tools
